weekend_note: Dry and mild through Friday (highs near 80, rain chance 7 percent or less), then showers become possible Halloween weekend: about 25 percent Saturday and Sunday, rising to roughly 50 percent early next week. Picks: the Temptations Revue at the fair tonight, free Bands on the Beach Tuesday, Blue Angels practice Wednesday morning, the Palafox Halloween Market and Taste of the Beach on Saturday, and Boo at the Zoo. Ice Flyers games on Oct 30 and Nov 1 are indoors if the weekend turns wet. Storm recovery from Isaias is ongoing, so double-check smaller events.

coverage_note: Written Sunday, Oct 25. Weather is from AccuWeather's 10-day page. Events draw on Must Do Pensacola's October guide, Visit Pensacola, WEAR's fair lineup, Winterfest and Beach Guide pages. NorthEscambia.com blocks automated reading, and Local Pulse, Fox10, WKRG and the Saenger, Bay Center and Blue Wahoos sites could not be opened directly, so Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah and Cantonment items are carried over from earlier checks and not reconfirmed. The Ice Flyers dates are carried over; the schedule source I read gave no game list. The Nov 4 downtown lighting date is unconfirmed (one calendar shows Nov 5). No restaurant openings or closings were newly confirmed beyond post-Isaias reopenings. News is limited to WEAR.
